scholarships.title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for students pursuing Bachelor and Masters level courses in Natural and Basic Sciences.
scholarships.award_details: Provides ₹60,000 cash scholarship and ₹20,000 summer mentorship grant.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Top 1% in Class 12th Board Exam, pursuing Natural/Basic Sciences.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Top 1% in Class 12th Board Exam
• Pursuing courses in Natural and Basic Sciences
• Age between 17-22 years

scholarships.title: Prime Minister's Scholarship Scheme (PMSS)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for wards and widows of deceased/ex-service personnel of Armed Forces.
scholarships.award_details: Monthly stipend of ₹3,000 for girls and ₹2,500 for boys.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Wards of Ex-Servicemen with min 60% in Class 12.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Wards of Ex-Servicemen
• Minimum 60% in Class 12 or Equivalent
• Pursuing first professional degree (BE, B.Tech, MBBS, etc.)

scholarships.title: Generation Google Scholarship (APAC)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for women in computer science to help excel in technology and become leaders in the field.
scholarships.award_details: A one-time award of $1,000 for the academic year.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Women students in CS or related technical fields across APAC.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Currently enrolled in a university
• Studying Computer Science or related technical field
• Academic excellence and leadership potential
scholarships.benefits:
• One-time financial award
• Google mentorship opportunities

scholarships.title: Tata Scholarship at Cornell University
scholarships.description: Full scholarship for Indian citizens to pursue undergraduate studies at Cornell University.
scholarships.award_details: Covers full tuition fees and potentially living expenses.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Indian citizens admitted to Cornell for undergraduate programs.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Indian citizen
• Admitted to Cornell University as an undergraduate
• Demonstrate financial need
scholarships.benefits:
• Full tuition fees
• Living expenses (in cases of extreme need)

scholarships.title: Adobe India Women-in-Technology Scholarship
scholarships.description: Scholarship for women students in India to support their education and careers in technology.
scholarships.award_details: Full tuition fee for one year and a paid internship opportunity.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Female students in CS/IT courses with strong academic record.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Female student enrolled in an Indian university
• Studying CS or Engineering
• Academic performance and technical skills
scholarships.benefits:
• Internship at Adobe India
• Tuition fee coverage for one year

scholarships.title: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means (SVMCM)
scholarships.description: Scholarship for meritorious students of West Bengal belonging to economically backward families.
scholarships.award_details: Monthly stipend of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 based on the course.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: WB residents with 60% in last exam and income < 2.5L.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Resident of West Bengal
• Minimum 60% in last qualifying exam
• Family income less than ₹2.5 Lakh per annum
scholarships.benefits:
• Monthly stipend based on course
• Financial support for higher education

scholarships.title: Oasis Scholarship (Pre-Matric & Post-Matric)
scholarships.description: Scholarship portal for students belonging to SC/ST/OBC categories in West Bengal.
scholarships.award_details: Maintenance allowance and fee reimbursement for SC/ST students.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: SC/ST/OBC students of WB with valid certificates.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Resident of West Bengal
• Belonging to SC/ST/OBC category
• Income limit as per category norms
scholarships.benefits:
• Hostel and maintenance allowance
• Tuition fee support

scholarships.title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
scholarships.description: Centrally sponsored scheme for meritorious students of economically weaker sections.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Class 8 students with min 55% and income < 3.5L.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Studying in Class 8
• Score at least 55% in Class 7
• Family income not exceeding ₹3,50,000

scholarships.title: HCL TechBee Early Career Program
scholarships.description: Work-integrated learning program for Class 12th students with financial support.
scholarships.award_details: Stipend during training and funding for higher education.
scholarships.eligibility_summary: Class 12 students with strong STEM background.
scholarships.eligibility:
• Class 12 students
• Minimum percentage as per regional board norms
• Indian citizen
scholarships.benefits:
• Monthly stipend
• Assured job at HCL after training
• Support for further education (B.Sc/B.Tech)
